summary: Microsoft Train Simulator entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Microsoft Train Simulator
entries.definitive_edition: Owned MSTS content with Open Rails for modern play, original executable for authenticity comparison

emulation.notes: Use Open Rails for current play; VM/original Windows only when exact MSTS behavior matters.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Open Rails for modern rendering; original MSTS on period Windows for authenticity

primary.version: Original MSTS assets through Open Rails when appropriate
primary.why: MSTS is an old Windows simulator with a large route/mod ecosystem. For current archive work, original MSTS assets plus Open Rails can provide modern graphics/performance and compatibility, while original MSTS remains the authenticity baseline.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned MSTS install and document whether running the original executable or Open Rails. Record version, route, activity, stock, mods, cab controls, timetable, physics/settings, display, and community content sources.

secondary.platform: Original MSTS executable on period Windows
secondary.why: Open Rails improves compatibility and visuals but is not identical to the original executable.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record route/mod sources and engine choice; community add-ons are not vanilla MSTS unless listed.
